project_updates.title: Investment audit — two facility proposals retained without relabeling them as spend
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Business Oregon LTREZ structured data and attachments; City budgets, development agreements and planning packets; Apple releases; assessor values; permit records; contractor pages; SEC search. Retained: DC No. 1 proposed investment $250,000,000 at 2012-04-12 certification and DC No. 2 proposed investment $226,400,000 at 2016-02-25 certification, both campus/facility scope, unallocated, source projections. Boundaries: the required minima were $8.5 million and $200 million; proposed investment is not realized spend, assessed value, permit valuation or selected-building cost. Negative findings/gaps: no audited annual or cumulative Apple Prineville capex, equipment/construction split, phase reconciliation or crosswalk from either DC label to IM3 building 00397914434.

project_updates.title: Construction audit — address inventory reviewed; no original-building valuation retained
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Oregon ePermitting Building; Crook County work-session/planning packets; City ordinances and budgets; Turner, Fortis, DPR, Southland, CriticalArc, Rosendin and NxGen references; OSHA and BOLI public pages. Anonymous ePermitting search used 01/01/2011-09/06/2026, street 1600, fragment Bal and city Prineville, producing 100+ records. Opened 217-26-000747-STR: Permit Issued, owner Apple, Turner Construction Company CCB 69988, 'Apple, IW ph2,' temporary 348-square-foot restroom job trailer. Boundaries: it is a 2026 phase-two temporary structure, not the selected 9,228-square-foot object or original 2012 build. Negative findings/gaps: no public original-building permit crosswalk, reconciled nonoverlapping permit ledger, verified construction expenditure, worker count, job-years, hours, payroll or local-hire share. No construction record retained.

project_updates.title: Supplier audit — contractor identities found without payment or geography evidence
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: ePermitting applicant/licensed-professional fields; Apple supplier-responsibility and jobs pages; Turner/Fortis/DPR/Rosendin/Southland/CriticalArc project pages; City/County procurement and council packets; Oregon CCB/BOLI portals. Turner is directly named on opened permit 217-26-000747-STR; other pages identify Prineville scopes for confidential or differently labeled campuses but do not establish Apple payment. Boundaries: contractor identity or office location is not supplier spend, local ownership, worker residence or selected-building attribution. Negative findings/gaps: no Apple Prineville vendor ledger, invoice, contract amount, recipient geography, local-purchase share, subcontract tier, household-spending input or nonoverlapping phase allocation. No supplier record retained.

project_updates.title: Operations audit — one reported jobs snapshot separated from forecasts and requisitions
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: joint City/Apple release; Business Oregon LTREZ facility rows; Apple Prineville careers; Central Oregon Community College; City Economic Opportunities Analysis; Oregon Employment Department/QualityInfo and WorkSource; BOLI apprenticeship/OATS. Boundaries: the 100 has no FTE, direct/contractor, residence, payroll or exact observation definition; open 2026 40-hour Apple requisitions are vacancies, not filled-job counts; the City's approximately 700 employees combines Apple and Meta. Negative findings/gaps: no reconciled current direct and contractor headcount, annual payroll, wage/occupation table, residence/local-hire realization, turnover or project apprenticeship count.

project_updates.title: Fiscal audit — taxable roll, bill and infrastructure contribution kept on separate scopes
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Crook County budgets and 2024-25/2025-26 top-taxpayer schedules; Property Search Online and payment-history tabs; Business Oregon IFA staff recommendation; City budgets, ACFRs, resolutions and development agreements; DOR tax and central-assessment pages. project_updates.title: Public-cost audit — ten potential-additional-tax observations and two exempt values retained
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Business Oregon re77-krua and attached 2016-2025 Crook County reports; City/County development agreements, budgets and allocation material; DOR enterprise-zone and tax-expenditure pages; assessor account notations. Retained: ten published company-level potential-additional-tax observations from $4,481,343.15 for 2015-16 through $21,430,063.20 based on 2024 values, plus DC No. 1 and No. 2 exempt assessed values of $661,684,410 and $762,455,049. project_updates.title: Resource audit — continuous campus electricity series added; water and permit gaps preserved
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Apple environmental reports 2014-2026; Oregon Department of Energy biennial report; OPUC direct-access/eDockets routes; OWRD WRIS and Prineville ASR applications/attachments; DEQ Your DEQ Online/pre-November-2024 archive and generic Tier 4 route; EPA facility search; City water budgets and agreements. Boundaries: 200 MW Montague and 56 MW Solar Star are generation agreements, not campus capacity; ASR storage is municipal system capacity, not Apple withdrawal; renewable generation equals annual use in some operator narratives but is not an independent meter. COCC confirms one described third-party-contract placement could earn three CIS credits and faculty toured the Apple site; the 2018 City release says Apple provided iPads to first responders. Boundaries: academic credits are not jobs or funding, and equipment without quantity/value/date is not a monetary contribution. Negative findings/gaps: no recipient-confirmed Apple Prineville award amount, annual grant ledger, payment date, in-kind valuation, volunteer-hour value or campus-versus-corporate allocation. No community record retained.

project_updates.title: Boundary and identity audit — one IM3 building separated from campus, facilities and accounts
project_updates.notes: IM3 selects one 9,228-square-foot building near 44.2894155, -120.8750775. Apple reports the Prineville data center renewable since opening May 2012; City/State planning material describes a 1600 SW Baldwin Road campus with three much larger buildings developed through 2023 and later expansions. On 2026-09-07 the Crook County portal was queried by Name=APPLE across pages 1-2: 15 Apple Inc. matches, 12 real and three personal, were distinguished from unrelated pineapple names. Real accounts span tax lots 15160700 00101/00102 and 15150000 00312. Opened account 19371 shows tax lot 151500-00-00312, enterprise-zone class, a 2012 industrial improvement and 2016-2025 values, but no building crosswalk; its payment-history table has no rows. Business Oregon separately labels DC No. 1 and No. 2. No parcel, account, DC facility or later phase is treated as the selected building.
project_updates.project_description: Apple's Prineville data-center project is an Apple-operated campus at 1600 SW Baldwin Road in Prineville, Crook County, Oregon; the selected IM3 object is one mapped 9,228-square-foot building, not the entire campus. Apple reports that the Prineville data center has used 100 percent renewable electricity since opening in May 2012, while public planning material describes three much larger campus buildings developed through 2023. Business Oregon separately labels two enterprise-zone facilities DC No. 1 and DC No. 2, and none of those campus or facility totals is allocated to the selected building.

project_updates.title: Directed portal audit — exact avenues, identifiers and negative findings recorded
project_updates.notes: Directed third audit used: Crook Property Search Online Name=APPLE and account 19371; Oregon ePermitting 01/01/2011-09/06/2026 at 1600 Bal, Prineville, including opened 217-26-000747-STR; Business Oregon Socrata re77-krua Apple Inc. DC No. 1/2 plus all ten attached reports; City ordinances 1195/1219, Resolutions 1571/1573 and budgets/EOA; OPUC eDockets/direct-access searches for Apple, Prineville and PacifiCorp; OWRD WRIS/ASR for Apple, Prineville, AL-26 and City rights; DEQ current/archive searches for Apple, Apple Inc., 1600 SW Baldwin and Prineville; EPA facility search; Apple jobs location=PVE; OED/QualityInfo/WorkSource; BOLI apprenticeship, OATS and training-agent routes; COCC and local recipients; SEC company/Prineville search; contractor/supplier pages for Turner, Fortis, DPR, Rosendin, Southland, CriticalArc and NxGen. Material false leads excluded: City Ordinances 1242/1243 concern Vitesse/Meta, PRN4 contractor pages are confidential or Meta, Apple Oregon tax-court cases are statewide corporate-income-tax matters, and 2025-26 top taxpayers omits Apple. No records requests were made.

project_updates.title: Modeling audit — every last-resort candidate rejected after direct-evidence review
project_updates.notes: Investment: rejected — direct facility forecasts exist, but no realized spend or selected-building allocation supports a truthful bound. Construction: rejected — no project worker count, duration, wage or original-building permit ledger. Suppliers: rejected — identities lack payments and geography. Operations: rejected — the 100-job snapshot lacks direct/contractor and residence definitions; continuous-coverage staffing would require unsupported post counts and shift assumptions. Fiscal: rejected — the company/county bill lacks account distribution and payment evidence; allocating it to one footprint would be arbitrary. Public costs: rejected — a same-account break-even would merely restate the unallocated tax bill while service costs, recipients and abatements use incompatible scopes. Resources: rejected — direct annual campus electricity already exists, while building allocation, water use and demand bounds lack defensible inputs. Community: rejected — no monetary recipient confirmation. County employment: rejected; County wages: rejected; County GDP: rejected — multiple Apple phases and Meta's separate campus defeat a credible treatment share and counterfactual. Modeled additions: zero; direct forecasts added: four.
